verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a test mode in which the authentication flow shows only Stripe-managed test institutions, and accounts can be linked from them without credentials. That covers sandbox linking. The pack does not show test-mode balance, ownership or transaction retrieval, or simulated error states such as failed logins or inactive accounts. missing for 10: documented test-mode data retrieval (balances/transactions/ownership), documented error-state simulation, explicit test credentials or scenario catalog, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox with test institutions and documented test credentials lets me exercise linking, data retrieval, and error states end-to-end before touching a real bank account

citations.quote: the authentication flow exclusively shows a selection of test institutions managed by Stripe. The client can link accounts from any of these institutions without providing credentials.
